pages.text: $(bold)Specialized Muzzleloading Ordnance$()$(br2)For close-quarters crowd dispersal and subterranean warfare, the arsenal produces Canister Scattershot and Incendiary Sulfur rounds.$(br2)Both require a powered 3x3 array of Create Mechanical Crafters to assemble.

$(bold)Incendiary Sulfur Round (3x3)$()$(br2)  S  $(br)C G C$(br)  W  $(br2)$(bold)Legend:$()$(br)S: Karst Sulfur (1)$()$(br)C: Large Bullet Core (2)$()$(br)G: Gunpowder Charge (1)$()$(br)W: Wad (1)$(br2)Yields 4 Incendiary Cartridges. Deals 35 kinetic damage and 8 seconds of fire.
